shared_elements: single human figure (head and upper body)
ornament worn on the chest/neck (disc pendant vs. bead necklaces)
ear ornament / ear rendered as a distinct element
justification: Both depict a single human personage wearing a tall headdress with an ornament suspended on the chest and banded detailing across the torso, which is a moderately specific shared scheme of an adorned dignitary bust. However, A is a frontal, massively schematic figure with a plain blocky face and a large plain disc, while B is a profile head with naturalistic facial modelling, patterned curled beard and hair, and beaded strands, so the depictive conventions and viewpoint have almost nothing in common.
